title: Meta Gives Muse a Real-Time Voice and Expressive Avatars
dek: US users can now talk out loud with Muse on mobile, web and Mac.

facts.label: Voice styles you can switch anytime
Avatar display modes, incl. voice only
Muse downloads within weeks of launch

caption:
Your Muse can now talk back, and it makes faces while you speak. 🎙️

Meta is rolling out real-time voice conversations and animated, expressive avatars in the Muse app, starting in the US on mobile, web and Mac. Tap the phone icon, start talking, and you can even interrupt Muse mid-reply. It runs on Meta's in-house Muse Realtime Voice and Muse Realtime Avatar systems, with hundreds of voices to choose from, from a New York attitude to a pirate's flair.

First previewed at Connect 2026, the feature puts Meta head to head with voice modes in ChatGPT and xAI's Grok Voice 3. Meta pitches it for trip planning, interview practice, presentation rehearsal and hands-free tasks, with voice coming soon to Meta AI Glasses and Muse Charm.

We're tracking every move in the voice assistant race here at AI Parabellum. Would you rather talk or type to your AI?

post_caption:
Typing prompts is starting to feel optional. Meta's Muse app now supports live voice chats with avatars that react with expressions and gestures as you talk, available in the US today.

Pick from hundreds of voices, go voice-only, or switch to full screen for face-to-face style practice before a big pitch.
